purpose: Pins the authenticated gateway GET /v1/models request/auth/response selection behavior used by #72: the supported client only adds ids beginning with claude/anthropic, and discovery results are cached between startups.

request.auth: RLY gateway/inference credentials (launch-session token or instance bearer)

note: A model is discoverable only when its access provider is enabled with an explicit provider->pool route, it has trusted registry evidence, and compatibility is VERIFIED by default (EXPERIMENTAL opt-in, BROKEN/unreviewed never).
